guitar.modelsText: Fender Jazzmaster / Gibson Les Paul / Gretsch
guitar.notes: Turner has used Jazzmasters, Gibson ES-335/Les Pauls, and various others over the band's career; no single iconic instrument, so medium confidence is appropriate.

tone.target: dry Arctic Monkeys crunch with wiry upper mids
tone.profile: dry Arctic Monkeys crunch with wiry upper mids
tone.summary: A classic British crunch chain using an OD boost (Tube Screamer style) into a UK 45 or UK 50 amp model, paired with a dry cab and slight room ambience for definition.
corrections: more clipped crunch than smooth overdrive

rig.name: Arctic Monkeys - Crying Lightning - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up hum and background noise.
Provide the tight, mid-focused breakup and 'Tube Screamer' emphasis required for the crunch.
Keep the tone focused on OD boost for crunch rather than heavy distortion.
Simulate the British amp character and punchy mids required for the Arctic Monkeys sound.
Provide the classic British cab sound and definition.
Sculpt the wiry upper mids and punchiness while controlling low-end mud.
Add a subtle, non-washed ambience to give the tone space without losing definition.

improvements.summary: Refine cabinet realism and mid-focus for a tighter, wirier crunch.

proposals.reason: The UK Vintage 4x12 might be too big; a smaller cab will tighten the low end and enhance the wiry upper mids.
